conversation.text:
Police: As far as I know, you did not go to the amusement park that day.
Respondent: I know you’re worried that Minghao will blame himself, but you shouldn’t think that way.
Respondent: How did you know?
Respondent: I already told him not to say anything...
Respondent: I told Minghao that it’s okay not to say anything...
Respondent: Xiyuan’s disappearance is not his fault.
Respondent: He thinks it happened because he didn’t want to stay with me.
Respondent: I was the one who failed to keep an eye on Xiyuan. It’s all my fault...
Respondent: I clearly told him that I was the one who lost Xiyuan.
